messages:
anna: FYI customer onboarding sample is creating huge concurrency spikes; new users hit our hosted endpoint and spawn background prefetches + UI queries. Seeing token-refresh retries and queue bloat.
tom: Can you share a timeline of events from signup -> prefetch -> first query?
anna: Roughly: signup webhook -> client boots sampleapp -> prefetch 40 docs concurrently -> each doc triggers 2 embed calls -> token refresh kicks in for a subset -> clients immediately retry. Result: ~50 concurrent inflight per client.
jeff: That's likely client-side overload + race on token refresh. Do we have a per-org quota bleed or global limiter hits?
li: Metrics show per-org 429s and also spikes on rate-limiter throughput. Root cause looks like N clients hitting refresh and retrying at same time.
anna: Proposed changes: (1) sampleapp default prefetch concurrency -> 8, (2) add client-side leaky-bucket/semaphore in SDK with default maxInflight=20, (3) token refresh dedupe (one inflight refresh per credential) + waiters, (4) short initial ramp with jitter on cold-start.
tom: Agree. For SDK parity, need to land the API in JS then mirror in Go/Python. Keep the config names consistent: max_inflight, ramp_ms, jitter_pct.
jeff: Suggestation: make token-refresh dedupe a Promise.join pattern: if refresh in-progress, return same promise to waiters. Also make retry logic respect the semaphore (i.e., don't bypass limiter).
li: Example pseudocode we discussed:
```js
// SDK internal
if (tokenExpired && !refreshPromise) {
  refreshPromise = refreshToken();
}
await refreshPromise; // waiters join here
// ensure request acquires semaphore before sending
await semaphore.acquire();
try { await sendRequest() } finally { semaphore.release() }
```
anna: Also recommend sampleapp add backoff on initial prefetch loops and a guard that switches to on-demand for >50 docs.
tom: Can ops temporarily increase quota for signup bursts as a mitigation?
li: We can bump quotas for a short window but would rather fix client smoothing.
jeff: I'll draft SDK PR for JS token dedupe + semaphore and add feature flag. Want unit tests around concurrent refresh and non-bypass behavior.
anna: I'll open sampleapp PR with concurrency cap + 800ms ramp + 30-50% jitter. I'll also add a small load harness script that simulates 200 signups at t=0 and records 429 rate.
ci-bot: sampleapp/pr-409 created and tests passed :white_check_mark:
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-901 "SDK semaphore + refresh-join pattern (JS/Go/Py)" https://redwood/devex/901
tom: After PRs merge, let's run a 200-org sim in staging. Goal: <2% 429s across startup window.
jeff: Also add a docs snippet in SDK README showing how to tune max_inflight for embedded devices vs server mode.
anna: Great. I'll post results tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
